key.name: show-gesture-path
key.description: Whether a gesture's path is drawn on screen while it's being drawn.

key.name: window-gap
key.description: Pixels between tiled windows and at the edges of the screen.

key.name: tile-automatically
key.description: Whether every workspace is tiled, also ones added later, without tiling each one.

key.name: tiled-workspaces
key.description: The places of the workspaces that are tiled, counting from 0, so that they're tiled again in the next session.

key.name: closed-sizes
key.description: What given-sizes holds, as versions before it kept it: one size for each app, of the last window that closed. It's moved there and emptied.

key.name: given-sizes
key.description: Windows the extension gave a size to, which their apps may have saved: for each app, each window's original width and height, the width and height it was given, and when, in seconds since 1970. They're kept while the windows are open too, in case the session ends without them getting their original size back. The next window the app opens at one of those sizes gets its original size back.
